problemas.description: Background animations impair readability.
Actions for reading are difficult to locate.
The contrast between elements is dark against a dark background.
Inconsistency in navigation - some panels lead directly to the map, while others do not.
Lack of standardized nomenclature - "Geospatial," "Geospatial Platform."
Functions with the same name redirect to different locations.
Entering a thematic panel does not provide feedback indicating selection.
No instructions on what to select to activate layers.
In the layer list, there is an info button that seems clickable but is not.
Colors are informative only, with no explanation of their meaning.
Color legends are only displayed when the layer is activated.
The activation button (eye icon) is unclear to users.
The button in "Planted Area" with sub-options is too small and unclear.
Activating a layer displays a number (active layer counter) without explanation.
Layer title suggests button functionality but is not a button.
Clearing layers lacks button affordance.
In filters, "culture" with a gray background appears disabled but is not.
In filters, municipal layers appear activated (in white) when they are not.
The difference between clearing layers at the top of filters and clicking filters below is unclear.
Clearing filters leaves municipal layers active without selecting a culture.
The order of interaction and field dependency in filter application is unclear.
The play button for advancing time is too fast, not allowing images to load.
The button to change speed does not clarify whether it will increase or decrease speed.
Changing to English or Spanish does not change the layer list.
Logging in - the process is unclear. Why log in? How to create an account?
Clicking on the map raises expectations of area details, but no information is provided.
Clicking the sandwich menu to return to the filter takes you back to the main menu of the Observatory.
The tutorial does not function.
